environment: Ubuntu 24.04.1 under WSL 2, Node 22.23.3, Playwright 1.56.0, Chromium 141.0.7390.37
method: The full visual suite ran without CI set, once with the default launch and once per flag set, through a configuration override that sets use.launchOptions.args (.github/ci-exploration/swiftshader.config.js on the ci-exploration branch). The captures of each run were compared byte for byte with the default run. Two more default runs measured run-to-run variation.

defaultReruns.note: Both are input fixtures whose captures depend on timing

variants.note: renderer_comprehensive fails in every run (0.12% of pixels over tolerance); print_comprehensive passes (0.046%)

conclusion: The WebGL renderer string is SwiftShader in every case, but --use-angle=swiftshader also changes how CSS-scaled canvases are composited, which changes print_comprehensive and renderer_comprehensive. --enable-unsafe-swiftshader and --disable-gpu reproduce the default renders. Failures in the swiftshader-webgl and disable-gpu-compositing runs are the timing-sensitive fixtures, not the flags.
